faq.q: Can you buy the Unitree H2?
faq.a: Yes, through dealers. The Unitree shop lists it but it was not orderable on 2026-10-14, while US Robot Store showed it in stock at $40,500.

faq.q: How much does the Unitree H2 cost?
faq.a: Unitree lists the base H2 at $29,900 before tax, shipping and duties. US dealers charge $39,900-$40,900 for the base robot and $68,900 for the H2 EDU.

faq.q: What is the difference between H2 and H2 EDU?
faq.a: Only the EDU version supports secondary development. Unitree asks buyers to contact sales for the EDU price.

faq.q: Can you rent a Unitree H2?
faq.a: Weston Robot rents the H2 for events at $18,000 per day plus transport. RobotLAB says it offers lease and subscription options.

notes: Several third-party sites say the base H2 ships with placeholder hands; the official pages do not say what hands are included, so this is not confirmed here. The October 2025 launch price comes from a blog, not a Unitree release. Dealer prices vary widely by compute and hand options (RobotLAB lists up to $240,000).
